jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
PROJECT MANAGER

This is a fully remote position.

PURPOSE

As a Project Manager within Ascend Enterprise Solution, you will lead medium-to-large technology projects using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies. You will collaborate with business leaders, technical teams, and clients to ensure successful project delivery, effective communication, and alignment with business objectives.

This role requires strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills to manage project execution, coordinate cross-functional teams, and support continuous improvement initiatives within the PMO. The ideal candidate will have experience managing multiple concurrent projects and working within both Agile and traditional delivery environments.

Responsibilities

Project Execution & Delivery

Lead technology projects from initiation through completion using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
Coordinate project resources and activities across multiple internal teams.
Track project progress, identify risks, and escalate issues when necessary.
Support project financial tracking, forecasting, and budget management.
Facilitate project meetings, sprint ceremonies, status updates, and stakeholder communications.
Ensure projects remain aligned with scope, timelines, and client expectations.
Assist in documenting lessons learned and identifying opportunities for process improvement.

Agile & Process Support

Lead and facilitate Agile ceremonies (e.g., Refinement Meetings, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives).
Serve as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach to enable Agile best practices across teams.
Work closely with Solution Architects to define, prioritize, and refine backlogs for iterative delivery.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and self-organization within Agile teams.
Track Agile team performance metrics, ensuring iterative delivery and continuous value creation.
Execute Waterfall & Hybrid Project Management
Develop full-scale project plans, including scope, milestones, risk assessments, and deliverables.
Define project tasks, dependencies, and resource requirements while ensuring alignment with business priorities.
Manage project budgets, financial forecasting, and resource allocation.
Plan, schedule, and track project timelines using Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid methodologies as appropriate.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination

Build strong working relationships with clients, stakeholders, and technical teams.
Coordinate with internal functional groups including Network, Operations, Cybersecurity, and Service Delivery teams.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and key milestones to stakeholders.
Assist with resolving project roadblocks and facilitating cross-functional collaboration.
Support governance and compliance requirements throughout project execution.

Team Development & Collaboration

Share project management best practices with peers and junior team members.
Contribute to a collaborative and continuous learning culture within the PMO.
Support onboarding and mentoring efforts for newer project managers when appropriate.

Minimum Skills, Education, And Experience

6 years of experience in IT project management.
Experience managing projects using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.
Working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, or Lean principles.
Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams.
Strong communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience managing project schedules, risks, budgets, and deliverables.
Proficiency with project management tools such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, or Microsoft Project.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Preferred Skills, Education, And Experience

Exposure to Agile transformation or PMO process improvement initiatives.
Experience supporting cloud or infrastructure-related projects.
PMP Certification (Preferred).
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or PMI-ACP Certification (Preferred).
Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) (Preferred).

Starting Compensation Range: $95,000 per year

The salary for this position is commensurate with experience, skills, and qualifications. The range is intended to reflect our commitment to attracting top talent, and the final offer will be based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's previous experience, expertise in the field, relevant certifications, and the specific requirements of the role. In addition, internal equity, market trends, and geographic location may also influence the final salary.

At Ascend Technologies we firmly believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not only fundamental values but also powerful drivers of innovation, growth, and success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.

CORE VALUES

We are seeking highly motivated individuals who have the willingness and ability to demonstrate Ascend core values:

Committed to Client Success: Our actions and our words always align with the best interest of the client.
One Team: We work collaboratively to overcome challenges with humility and respect and do what it takes to find innovative solutions.
Integrity: We are unquestionably committed to doing the right thing even when it is hard.
Accountability: We hold ourselves and each other accountable for keeping our commitments to our clients, our communities, and one another.
Transparency: We create open lines of communication with each other and our clients, fostering relationships founded on candor and trust.

Physical Demands

Must be able to sit, stand, and bend for the duration of shift. The position is mainly sitting, with occasional lifting up to 50 lbs, such as laptop, server equipment, and, driving to the work site to meet with client(s).

Utility and Owner satisfaction with substation delivery and commissioning outcomes
Compliance with interconnection agreements and regulatory standards

Timely procurement and delivery of long-lead HV equipment
Positive contribution to team morale, training, and development
Advancement of internal best practices for substation project management

Experience with working withing the Norh East Region of the country
Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary substation projects through full lifecycle—from kickoff to energization

Experience managing Transmission Line construction

Strong interpersonal and communication skills to manage client, utility, and subcontractor interfaces
Ability to identify, prioritize, and resolve project challenges with limited supervision

This role oversees project execution related to schedule, budget, scope coordination, and cross-department communication while partnering closely with CAD, Production, Installation, Logistics, and Estimating teams.

The Project Manager serves as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned projects and is expected to maintain clear communication with clients, vendors, and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.

The Project Manager should possess a strong understanding of scenic fabrication and installation workflows to effectively coordinate technical discussions, communicate project impacts, and relay information between clients and internal teams. This role is not responsible for engineering, drafting, or making final technical design decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Execution

Manage assigned scenic, Spacecube, and temporary structure projects from turnover through final closeout.
Develop and maintain project schedules, deliverables, labor plans, and execution timelines.
Coordinate project scope, assumptions, milestones, and client expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
Independently manage low to moderate complexity projects while assisting on larger or higher complexity projects.
Serve as the primary internal point of contact for assigned projects.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate with CAD to ensure drawings and project documentation align with fabrication and client requirements.
Partner with Production, Fabrication, Paint, and Installation teams to support project sequencing and execution.
Work closely with Inventory, Logistics, and Yard teams to ensure material readiness and project support needs are met.
Collaborate with Estimating regarding scope changes, project impacts, and budget considerations.
Support onsite planning related to labor, equipment, logistics, and installation readiness.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Lead client meetings and maintain professional communication throughout project execution.
Communicate schedule updates, scope impacts, risks, and project status proactively with clients and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate information flow between technical teams and clients to ensure alignment and understanding of project requirements.
Participate in project review meetings and assist with documenting action items and follow-up tasks.
Support review and coordination of graphics, client-provided assets, and third-party procurement requirements.

Budget, Risk & Change Management

Track project budgets, labor usage, schedules, and execution progress.
Identify and communicate potential project risks, schedule concerns, or cost impacts early.
Coordinate change order requests and scope revisions with the Estimating Department for review and processing.
Support efforts to maintain project profitability, quality standards, and operational efficiency.
Escalate significant project concerns or execution risks to leadership appropriately.

Process, Safety & Operational Standards

Follow company SWIs, documentation standards, and safety protocols.
Generate inventory take-offs (pull lists) and load lists in coordination with Inventory and Logistics teams.
Generate Bills of Materials and assist with sourcing non-inventoried items as needed.
Support onsite Emergency Action Plan coordination with the Safety team.
Participate in post-project reviews and continuous improvement discussions.
Lead internal pre-planning meetings and review project scope, schedules, and execution plans with onsite teams.
Support onsite installations and travel as required.

5+ years of project management experience in scenic fabrication, live events, entertainment production, temporary structures, or related industries.
Strong understanding of scenic fabrication, temporary structures, and installation workflows.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in fast-paced environments with tight deadlines.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Oversee material procurement efforts—particularly long-lead substation components such as power transformers, breakers, steel structures, control enclosures, relays, and communication systems
Facilitate construction schedule and scope review meetings, highlighting critical paths for substation construction and energization
Lead site Kick-Off Meetings, Pre-Commissioning Walks, and Energization Readiness Reviews specific to HV equipment
Coordinate PV and substation energization support including relay testing, functional checkouts, and utility witness testing

Ensure a safe work environment and enforce safety practices around energized substations and high-voltage equipment
Maintain flexible availability for substation construction and commissioning events, which may occur outside regular business hours
Regular travel required to project sites, utility offices, and vendor facilities
Support continuous improvement, lessons learned, and standardization efforts across substation projects
Complete additional responsibilities as assigned

Objectives or Goals to Measure Performance:

Adherence to company procedures, safety manuals, and substation-specific safety protocols
Substation scope completion on schedule and within budget
High performance and coordination across engineering, construction, and subcontractor teams
Utility and Owner satisfaction with substation delivery and commissioning outcomes
Compliance with interconnection agreements and regulatory standards
Minimal change orders, RFIs, or rework on substation scope
Timely procurement and delivery of long-lead HV equipment
Positive contribution to team morale, training, and development
Advancement of internal best practices for substation project management

Minimum Skills Or Experience Requirements

Minimum 5 years of experience in substation design, construction, or commissioning of utility-scale or industrial high-voltage (69kV to 500kV) systems
Experience with working withing the Norh East Region of the country
Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary substation projects through full lifecycle—from kickoff to energization
Familiarity with substation components: transformers, circuit breakers, switchgear, grounding, control buildings, protection & control, relays, SCADA, etc.
Experience managing Transmission Line construction

NFPA 70E “Qualified Person” preferred; must be familiar with energized work practices and LOTO protocols
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to manage client, utility, and subcontractor interfaces
Ability to identify, prioritize, and resolve project challenges with limited supervision

Experience with CAD, PDF markup tools, and field documentation platforms is a plus

jobs.title: Project Manager - New Homes Accelerator
jobs.description:
Housing and Land

The Housing and Land directorate is responsible for the Mayor’s plans to deliver new and improved homes and strong communities. Working closely with boroughs and partners, we manage the Mayor’s housing investment programmes and land and property assets to support the building of affordable homes, job creation and regeneration.

About The Team

The New Homes Accelerator Team is a new team in the Investment and Operations Unit in the Housing and Land directorate.

The Government’s New Homes Accelerator (NHA) is a programme established by the Ministry for Housing, Communities and Local Government (MHCLG) to speed up the delivery of large-scale housing developments that have stalled. The NHA aims to increase the delivery of homes by the end of this Parliament (2029). Since the NHA was established, MHCLG, GLA and London Councils officers have worked in partnership to analyse London’s stalled sites and identify suitable interventions to accelerate their delivery, but are now taking this to the next level.

In early 2026, we took this to the next level by establishing the NHA LDN team, to take a more proactive, London-led role, to identify stalled housing sites and finding practical ways to get them moving again. That means using our powers, data and networks to make things happen. We escalate sites where delivery challenges cannot be addressed through these resources to the MHCLG NHA team for action. They will then provide support with engagement where the challenges relate to other government departments or will work to address policy and systems issues if these are the blockers.

This GLA New Homes Accelerator Team acts as our central point of coordination within the GLA to other internal teams and to MHCLG, London boroughs and external partners, minimising disjointed or duplicative communication to key partner organisations. They will work closely with other teams to unblock sites and get homes built in London.

About The Roles

This is your chance to play a central role in unblocking stalled sites and getting London’s housebuilding moving again. As one of the NHA Project Managers you will support the Senior Manager and work with GLA teams, Homes England, Government and other partners, to help unlock stalled housing sites and get homes built faster. You will:

take a London-led approach (in close collaboration with ATLAS London) to data collection and analysis to identify genuinely stalled sites in London
work with existing networks, teams and site lists to prioritise which sites should be supported through the NHA
identify ways to unblock and accelerate sites, focusing on using existing GLA powers, resources, funding and brokerage
work with GLA teams to unblock the sites and get homes built
triage sites that can’t be unblocked through our own resources and powers to the MHCLG NHA team where other solutions, such as more senior political brokering or national policy interventions will unblock them
maintain regular and open communications with the MHCLG team about progress on unblocking sites.

What your day will look like

You Will Manage Key Relationships Across GLA Teams, Homes England And Government And Provide Specialist Technical Development Support To Help Identify Solutions Which Will Accelerate Housing Delivery Across a Range Of Schemes In London. This Will Include

giving professional and technical advice to help accelerate housing delivery on London schemes through the New Homes Accelerator programme – this could include development viability, project finance, planning, brokerage and escalating issues to other GLA teams or Government
managing New Homes Accelerator London projects and related initiatives effectively, making sure all records are accurate and kept up to date
reporting on projects clearly and regularly, including outputs, budgets and risks – prepare dashboards and update papers for DMT, Deputy Mayors, the London Housing Mission Board, the New Homes Accelerator Steering Group and other key forums
identifying project proposals that meet Mayoral and Government objectives for new homes, and work with partners to bring these forward so homes are delivered by 2029.

Skills, Knowledge And Experience

To be considered for the role you must meet the following essential criteria:

good understanding of how the development sector works – including its economic, financial and organisational challenges across both private and public organisations
excellent relationship-building skills – you’ll work with a wide range of partners, share knowledge and collaborate to achieve shared goals (building and managing relationships level 3)
strong strategic thinking skills – you can see the bigger picture to uncover potential challenges and opportunities for the long term (level 3 strategic thinking)

Please See The Full Job Description Here

The GLA Competency Framework Guidelines further detailing each competency and the different level indicators can be found here:
GLA Competency Framework

This role is based at London Fire Brigade’s Head Office (Union Street SE1 0LL).

We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

How to apply

Up to date CV
Personal statement with a maximum of 1500 words. Please ensure you address how you demonstrate the skills, knowledge and experience outlined above in the advert.

Please ensure your CV and Personal Statement have a maximum file size of 1.5MB each and upload your Personal Statement to the ‘CV and Cover Letters’ section’ of the form, ensuring you address the skills, knowledge and experience in your Personal Statement.

Word or PDF format preferred and do not include any photographs or images. Please ensure your CV and Personal Statement are saved with the job reference number as part of the naming convention (E.g., “CV – applicant name - 012345)

As part of GLA’s continuing commitment to be an inclusive and equal opportunity employer we will be removing personal identifiable information from CVs and Personal Statements that could cause discrimination.

We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications.

If you have questions about the role

Is this role eligible for sponsorship?

This role DOES NOT meet the criteria for sponsorship for external candidates. It may meet the criteria for sponsorship for some internal candidates, in limited circumstances. Please contact the hiring manager if you wish to discuss this further.

Assessment process

Once you have submitted an application, your details will be reviewed by a panel.

If shortlisted, you’ll be invited to an interview/assessment.

The interview/assessment date is: TBC

Equality, diversity and inclusion

London's diversity is its biggest asset, and we strive to ensure our workforce reflects London's diversity at all levels. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of age, gender, gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, sexual orientation, faith or disability.

We particularly encourage applications from Black, Asian and Minority ethnic candidates and disabled candidates who are currently underrepresented in our workforce.

We are committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We would welcome applications from candidates who are seeking part time work as this role is open to job share.

Please note we are a Disability Confident Employer so for candidates who wish to be considered under the scheme and meet the essential criteria, they will automatically be invited to interview. Please note, should you require any adjustments through the process, we will accommodate as much as possible. Please contact the recruitment team for further information if required.

Benefits

GLA staff are hybrid working up to 3 days a week in our offices and remotely depending on their role. As part of this, you will need to split your time between home working and coming into the office.

In addition to a good salary package, you will be paid every four weeks, providing frequent salary payments. We also offer an attractive range of benefits including 30 days’ annual leave, interest free season ticket loan, interest free bicycle loan and a career average pension scheme.

Additional Information

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record (DBS) check but some roles may require additional security screening.

jobs.description:
About CDI

The Constructive Dialogue Institute (CDI) is a non-partisan, non-profit dedicated to equipping the next generation of Americans with the skills to communicate and collaborate across lines of difference. We work with U.S. colleges and universities by providing co-curricular programming for students, professional development for faculty and staff, and strategic guidance to leadership. Our goal is to foster constructive dialogue at every level of the institution and to create the conditions for lasting organizational change. CDI was co-founded by psychologist Jonathan Haidt, the bestselling author of The Righteous Mind and The Anxious Generation .

About the Role

CDI seeks an experienced, highly organized Senior Program Manager to serve as the operational backbone of the Leadership Institute (LI), CDI's program to equip senior higher education leaders with the strategy, tools, and peer network to advance cultures of inquiry and dialogue on their campuses. This full-time, remote role works closely with the Vice President of Leadership Programs to run LI's full-year arc: the fall Summit, monthly institutional coaching, quarterly Peer Learning Communities, and each cohort's measurement and reporting cycle.

In your first 90 days
, you'll learn LI end-to-end by shadowing coaching calls and supporting Summit planning, getting fluent in our systems and templates, and planning for the year-long engagement. By month three, you'll independently manage scheduling and logistics for our Leadership Institute partners.
By month six
, you'll manage the operating rhythm for the full cohort year, tracking institution progress, flagging risks to the VP, running day-to-day partner communication, and recommending process improvements.
Within your first year
, you'll be a trusted first point of contact for campus teams on coordination and progress, and a trusted operational partner with the VP.

The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of program operations and relationship management: strong execution, an instinct for spotting opportunities and process improvements, and good judgment about what to flag versus solve directly. The Senior Program Manager reports to the Vice President of Leadership Programs.

Responsibilities

Program & Portfolio Management

Own the schedule and tracking systems for the full LI cohort's year-long arc, including summit prep with the institution teams, monthly coaching, and quarterly Peer Learning Community sessions
Keep the Vice President and broader team ahead of deadlines across all concurrent workstreams, within and across cohort years.
Track each institution's strategic priorities throughout the year and escalate stalled progress or risks.
Identify and design improvements to LI's operating systems and templates (discovery process, communications cadence, reporting formats) in partnership with the VP.

Institution & Partner Liaison

Serve as the primary point of contact for institutional teams on scheduling, onboarding, pre-work, and follow-up across the full year.
Field routine questions and troubleshoot logistics directly.
Spot opportunities raised by campus partners and elevate them to the VP

Cross-Team Coordination & Communication

Manage meeting cadence and information flow among the VP, consulting, partnerships, and impact teams
Maintain and organize program materials, including discovery reports, session decks, PLC, and coaching resources
Model clear, professional communication in every touchpoint with institutional partners

Data Tracking & Reporting

Track Pillar-specific progress and coaching-call reflections across the cohort.
Synthesize cohort-wide data into formats leaders can act on, including progress dashboards, insights reports, and summaries.

About You

An experienced program manager.
You bring 5+ years of program or project management experience, ideally spanning cross-functional or partner-facing work in education, consulting, or nonprofit settings.
A skilled portfolio juggler.
You're comfortable managing a complex, multi-institution portfolio and tracking multiple workstreams at once.
A proactive process-improver.
You have a track record of independently identifying and proposing improvements, not just executing what's handed to you.
A trusted external liaison.
You're comfortable liaising directly with external partners on defined pieces of work, with good judgment about what to resolve independently versus escalate.
Data-savvy.
You can pull information from multiple sources (surveys, interviews, documents) into a clear, decision-ready narrative.
A strong communicator.
Your written and verbal communication is excellent, calibrated for both internal teams and senior higher-ed leadership.
Mission-aligned and adaptable.
You're enthusiastic about CDI's mission and comfortable operating in an environment of continuous improvement as the LI program evolves year to year.
Preferred:
Comfort with project management systems and CRMs (e.g., Asana, HubSpot).

— we practice what we preach, so our work culture is characterized by intellectual humility, continuous improvement, and open-mindedness
Remote-First

jobs.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Enterprise Project Manager

Canonical’s mission is to streamline and accelerate the adoption of open source across the entire global enterprise technology market. Our customers embrace the Canonical approach to open source for complex projects on bare metal, on the cloud, and at the edge. Canonical Enterprise Project Managers are responsible for ensuring project success through owning, driving, communicating and respectfully engaging all stakeholders, valuing integrity and accountability.

Within a portfolio of projects with complex and changing software technologies, customer and partner satisfaction is only possible because of exceptional Project Managers who know how to respect and engage all stakeholders.

Location:
This is a Globally remote role.

The role entails

Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations
Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place
Maintaining strong customer focus and working with all key stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes
Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and providing direction when needed
Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project
Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio
Driving project success while managing risks

What we are looking for in you

Experience in Enterprise IT Programs, Process Improvement, and Software Engineering Project Management
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Experience leading cross-cultural, remote and global project teams and customers.
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Strong communication skills
Deep understanding of Linux, Open Source, and Cloud Technologies
Bachelor's Degree in a STEM discipline
Project Management Certification, preferably PMP or equivalent certification
Agile Project Management certification, preferably Scrum Master or equivalent certification
Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally

What We Offer Colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Focus Groups & Qualitative Insights

Playbooks & Enablement
— Educate customer-facing teams on our survey initiatives and feedback processes. Design playbooks for pre- and post-survey outreach that align with best practices on responding to customer feedback in a supportive manner.

Program Strategy & Analytics
— Build executive dashboards and quarterly reporting to track core CX metrics, customer sentiment trends, and the ROI of VoC initiatives. Establish automated workflows to flag and address detractor issues in real time.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Program Manager for our Engineering Operations team to help us reach our goals and make our Engineering team the best it can be!

The mission for the Staff Program Manager, Engineering Operations, is to maintain and accelerate the highest level of execution excellence of Fivetran engineering. Our Engineering organization comprises several global functional groups that use a range of processes, systems, tools, and KPIs to jointly deliver best-in-class data pipelines and drive innovation.

The role focuses on increasing the efficiency and effectiveness of one or more of our Engineering functions in delivering our strategic objectives by streamlining engineering processes and leading major initiatives, such as process and efficiency improvement projects & programs.

As the majority of the processes are in the software development industry, the role assumes you have broad experience in software development and have led multiple programs that shipped software from start to finish. You have worked closely with cross-functional teams with design, research, product, and engineering. Preferably, you work at a tech company and are heavily involved in engineering operations, with a deep understanding of how engineering processes work under the hood and how to take them to the next level.

We want you to bring your passion for problem-solving, experience in the tech world, and the drive to help us get to the next level, and have some fun along the way.

This is a full-time position based out of our Bengaluru office.

Technologies You’ll Use

Jira, Google Workspace, Notion, Claude Cowork/Code, Slack, Lucidchart, Looker, BigQuery, ChatGPT/codex

What You’ll Do

Ensure operations and strategy execution work seamlessly and effectively, and streamline engineering processes so they are simple, value-oriented, and scalable.
Oversee operations for your respective global group, with a particular focus on increasing efficiency, stability, and effectiveness in delivering their strategic objectives.
Act as a strategic partner for the global group leader regarding short and long-term vision, planning (quarterly and annual), and execution, as well as establishing and tracking engineering OKRs and KPIs. All this with consistent alignment with engineering-wide policies and practices.
Maintain the engineering process library and improve it in collaboration with process owners, other operations managers, the PMO, engineering leadership, and leadership of partnering departments such as Product, Analytics, and Design.
Lead and manage process and efficiency improvement programs aiming to set up or improve engineering and cross-departmental processes, from problem definition and data analysis through solution proposal, stakeholder alignment, and execution — resulting in documented, repeatable, and measurable processes.
Collaborate and openly debate with the team of operations managers to manage engineering initiatives, solve problems, discuss challenges, and learn more about critical issues as a group of Engineering Operations.
Work with Engineering teams to ensure adherence to operational processes, conduct process audits and check-ins, and discuss opportunities for improvement with senior engineers and engineering leadership, identifying opportunities to optimize and automate routine operations.
Provide leadership, improvement, and support of our internal knowledge management process and information structure in collaboration with PMO, technical enablement teams, and technical writers.
Support the coordination, preparation, and delivery of company-wide engineering updates and events.
Act as a role model and a champion for operational excellence, project management practices, risk management, and security practices.

Skills We’re Looking For

10+ years of experience in technical/operations management in the technology/software development industry.
Ability to work directly with senior leadership on strategic programs, including leading cross-functional R&D initiatives from start to finish.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, working independently, and problem-solving within fast-paced and constantly changing environments.
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact and collaborate with technical and non-technical groups at all levels.
A data-driven and action-oriented mindset with excellent planning, analytical, problem-solving, project/program management, organizational, and leadership skills.
Ability to identify and meet with key players and stakeholders to shape consensus collectively and engage in dialogue to reach a conclusion, compromising as necessary for results.
You are fearless, goal-focused, and pragmatic, and you understand the complexity of working with a multitude of different teams and people.
You are recognized as a go-to expert in one or more engineering operations domains (e.g., System Design, Data Architecture, Infrastructure Management, including cost management, Quality) and use that expertise to drive innovation in how your global group approaches them - not just facilitate conversations, but shape and influence the technical direction of SDLC and process decisions.
Stays current on industry trends and business developments relevant to engineering operations, and applies that context to inform recommendations and decisions.
Ability to leverage AI to increase your own productivity and leverage it in the solutions you're building.

(Optional)Bonus Skills

Experience driving projects end-to-end, and shipping complex, large-scale software projects with global teams utilizing different SDLCs.
Familiarity with project management tools like Jira, knowledge management tools like Notion, and analytical tools like Looker and Sigma.
Experience working with cloud platforms and SaaS companies is a plus.
Familiarity with the following technologies is a plus: Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), ETL or ELT, modern data stack.

RSU stock grants*
Professional development and training opportunities

Founded by a decorated twenty-eight year Veteran of the United States Army, Blue Water Thinking understands and supports the mission of our Nation's war fighters, Veterans, their families and caretakers.

Fueled by our values of integrity, respect, professionalism, stewardship and customer service, the Blue Water Thinking team understands the power of the human connection, collaboration, humility and loyalty to one another, our clients and industry partners.

Lastly, our formula for success is simple: Build something good, take care of our people, keep our clients satisfied, nurture our work ethic and reputation, build long-lasting partnerships, enjoy what we do and give back as much as possible.

Job Description

Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Program Manager to support a large project at the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The Program Manager will oversee execution across multiple integrated workstreams, including program planning, federal oversight and audit response, recommendation management, acquisition risk governance, performance measurement and reporting, control environment improvements, strategic assessments, executive communications, and change management. The successful candidate will combine disciplined program leadership with deep knowledge of federal acquisition management, acquisition risk management, and oversight-driven transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Serve as the contractor’s functional expert and day-to-day program management lead, maintaining proactive and responsive communication with the Contracting Officer’s Representative, Government program leadership, senior executives, and other client stakeholders.
Lead and coordinate contractor personnel across all task areas, establishing clear roles, work plans, priorities, schedules, dependencies, and accountability for timely, high-quality performance.
Oversee development, maintenance, and execution of the program management plan, including the integrated schedule, milestones, staffing, resource allocation, risks, issues, quality assurance, and performance controls.
Manage contract execution and administration, including deliverable tracking, financial and labor-hour monitoring, staffing and vacancy management, compliance with task order requirements, change control, and support for contract modifications and closeout.
Direct preparation of recurring task reports, status briefings, monthly progress reports, quarterly accomplishment reports, and period closeout reports, ensuring accurate reporting of accomplishments, planned activities, expenditures, risks, issues, and personnel status.
Provide leadership for federal acquisition management and oversight activities, including strategic action planning, recurring external reporting, recommendation response packages, progress updates, closure requests, and long-term program improvement and exit-readiness strategies.
Coordinate input and facilitate collaboration across federal organizations, acquisition subject matter experts, cross-functional workgroups, governance bodies, and other internal and external stakeholders.
Ensure alignment of program activities and deliverables with applicable federal acquisition requirements, internal control standards, enterprise risk management practices, the Federal Acquisition Regulation, and relevant agency policies and governance issuances.

Minimum of ten (10) years of experience in federal acquisition management, acquisition risk management, or federal program management.
Minimum of five (5) years of experience supporting federal oversight, audit, accountability, or performance-improvement activities, including direct experience supporting Government Accountability Office engagements or comparable federal review processes.
Experience supporting major federal program offices or organizational components; Department of Veterans Affairs experience is strongly preferred.
Significant experience developing strategic action plans, responding to oversight recommendations, preparing progress updates and closure packages, and engaging with federal audit or oversight bodies.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and coordinating complex work across senior leadership, program offices, functional experts, and external oversight stakeholders.
Strong knowledge of federal acquisition management and acquisition risk management processes, governance, internal controls, corrective action management, and performance measurement.
Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to develop and present concise, decision-ready materials for senior executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to establish program governance, integrated schedules, reporting processes, risk and issue management, quality controls, and resource management practices.
Detail-oriented, highly organized, strategic, proactive, and able to manage multiple high-priority deliverables under tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master’s degree in business, public administration, acquisition management, program management, risk management, or a related field.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Experience within a federal acquisition, program management, enterprise risk, internal control, or oversight organization.
Experience standing up or maturing a program management office, integrated risk management capability, governance structure, corrective action program, or enterprise performance reporting function.
Experience with executive dashboards, recommendation and corrective-action tracking systems, SharePoint-based collaboration environments, and data-driven performance reporting.

ABOUT US

By combining our unparalleled domain expertise with leading-edge technology, Ad Astra is helping higher education in its mission to advance timely student completions. We are building a cloud-based software platform that will provide the foundation for our next generation of industry-leading solutions and analytics. Simply put, we're helping students graduate faster.

OUR CORE VALUES

We recognize talent. We recognize and appreciate the unique God-given talents that our people bring to Ad Astra. Aligning these individual gifts with our work sets team members up to succeed.
We’re unpretentious. There’s no room for ego. We admit our imperfections and have the humility to know what we don’t know.
We’re passionate. We aren’t satisfied with the status quo. We’re on a mission together to protect the value of degree completion and to transform the higher education industry.
We’re pioneering. We’re pioneering and aren’t afraid of failing—in fact, we celebrate it. We love it when our people boldly experiment with innovative solutions.
We love fun. The health of our relationships is strengthened by working with people who stretch our thinking—and by enjoying the lighter side of life together. We don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we do take fun seriously.
We have grit. Beyond talent and intelligence, our people have stick-to-itiveness. We push through challenges to make goals a reality.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Program Manager, Insights and Advisory Services, plays a key role in coordinating and supporting Ad Astra’s work to assist colleges and universities with improving course scheduling to decrease time to degree and advance student success on their campuses. The Program Manager oversees day-to-day program operations across the team’s service lines and serves as a coordinator between team leadership, contract consultants, internal partners, and participating institutions.

The Program Manager manages timelines, deliverables, and coordination needs across concurrent client engagements, including technical assistance, benchmarking cohorts, consulting engagements, and workshop delivery, ensuring that program activities advance on schedule and at a consistent standard of quality. In addition to delivery coordination, the Program Manager monitors and manages the financial and operational health of the technical assistance portfolio, including project margins, on-time delivery, client satisfaction, and revenue recognition reporting, escalating margin and capacity risks to team leadership. The Program Manager also serves as the day-to-day relationship manager for the system offices with which Ad Astra partners, maintaining regular communication cadences with system office stakeholders, coordinating multi-institution cohorts and system-sponsored initiatives, and ensuring that system-level priorities and reporting expectations are reflected in engagement design and delivery.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Create and implement program plans identifying key milestones and deliverables for each active engagement and cohort.
Support tracking engagement deliverables against program plans; identify significant variances and escalate capacity or timeline risks.
Serve as coordinator of day-to-day program activities and internal point person/liaison across the four service lanes.
Coordinate and lead regular program team meetings; capture and disseminate key takeaways and action items.
Coordinate and manage the technical assistance program, including engagement cadence, institutional touchpoints, and follow-through across the active TA portfolio.
Coordinate with contract (1099) consultants on their scope of work, assignments, deliverables, and related activities.
Manage ongoing relationships with partner system offices, including engagement cadence, system-level status reporting, and coordination of multi-institution cohorts and initiatives sponsored or funded at the system level.
Manage contact information, engagement records, and status documentation for participating institutions.
Monitor and manage project margins for technical assistance engagements against established thresholds; where margins fall below threshold, develop recommended plans to improve margin performance and escalate to team leadership for decisions affecting staffing mix, scope, or pricing.
Report program performance to leadership on a regular cadence, including project margins, on-time delivery performance, and client satisfaction (CSAT); provide monthly revenue recognition reporting to Finance.
Coordinate scheduling, logistics, and preparation for client convenings, workshops, and cohort gatherings, both virtual and in-person.
Manage the workflow for participant deliverables and submissions (e.g., action plans, cohort assignments), including collection, routing to subject matter reviewers, and tracking feedback turnaround.
Provide production and logistics support for the delivery of curriculum webinars and virtual program sessions.
Coordinate the development, versioning, and delivery logistics of workshop curricula, facilitation guides, certification materials, and other program assets; maintain the team’s library of reusable materials.
Support the development of internal and external training programs for Astra Institute certifications, including the design of assessments that measure participant mastery of the curriculum delivered.
Support the connection of engagement curricula, outcomes, and deliverables to the team’s larger body of previous and in-progress work, ensuring continuity and reuse across engagements.
Support the rollout and consistent use of internal methodology standards, templates, and documentation practices across the team.
Assist team with development and approval of program reports, client communications, and deliverables.
Assist team with design and delivery of program activities that lead to specified engagement outcomes.
Travel to and represent Ad Astra at approved conferences, client convenings, and events that occur within the program calendar.
Other duties as assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s Degree
Five or more years of experience in program or project management in a same or similar role
Proven experience in program or project management, particularly in the education sector, including coordination of multiple concurrent workstreams with distinct stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
Experience with project management tools and techniques (e.g., Asana, Smartsheet, Monday.com, or similar.
Experience managing project financial performance, including monitoring project margins, tracking revenue recognition, and reporting program metrics (e.g., margin, on-time delivery, client satisfaction) to leadership and finance partners.
Experience working in higher education including a strong understanding of higher education policies, practices, and challenges.
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain program plans, delivery calendars, and status reporting across a portfolio of engagements.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including client executives and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to think strategically, solve problems, and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through across competing priorities.

Ability to travel periodically for client convenings, conferences, and team events.

ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES

Problem Solving
Collaborative Communication
Program and Project Management
Organization and Follow-Through
Financial and Operational Acumen
Stakeholder and Relationship Management
Adaptability in a Fast-Paced Environment

ADDITIONAL PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Project Management Certification (PMP or comparable) preferred

HOW PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED FOR THIS ROLE

On-time delivery of engagement milestones and deliverables across the active portfolio, measured against approved program plans.

This Compliance Transformation Program Manager plays a central part in that mandate by serving as the program management and execution lead for TDS Compliance’s transformation portfolio. It helps connect Compliance strategy to delivery by maintaining an integrated view of priorities, tracking remediation commitments, coordinating technology investment planning, challenging project owners on execution readiness, and producing senior-level reporting. In practice, the role ensures that high-priority initiatives are not managed in silos, but are coordinated, measurable, and delivered with the right level of accountability, transparency, and control focus.

Depth & Scope:

Lead program management for TDS Compliance initiatives, ensuring strong governance, disciplined execution, and timely delivery of strategic, regulatory, remediation, and control-related priorities.

Partner across Compliance, Technology, 1A/1B, Risk, Legal, Operations, and other stakeholders to translate Compliance priorities into executable plans and deliverables.
Monitor portfolio health and identify emerging risks, including delivery challenges, resource constraints, budget pressures, and control implications.
Improve execution practices across TDS Compliance by standardizing templates, strengthening governance routines, enhancing reporting, improving dependency management, and reducing fragmented or manual processes.

Education & Experience:

15+ years of progressive experience in Compliance, Risk, Regulatory, Audit, Controls, Program Management, or Transformation roles within a global financial services, capital markets, broker-dealer, or similarly complex regulated environment.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale transformation, remediation, regulatory response, control enhancement, or operating model change programs with senior leadership visibility and cross-functional dependencies.
Strong understanding of Compliance operating models, regulatory expectations, 2nd Line of Defense responsibilities, risk management frameworks, control design, issue management, surveillance, monitoring, testing, governance, and remediation execution.
Proven ability to translate complex Compliance, regulatory, audit, or control priorities into structured execution plans, milestones, deliverables, governance routines, progress reporting, and escalation mechanisms.

Strong program governance and portfolio management capabilities, including the ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives concurrently, maintain an integrated view of execution health, and identify emerging delivery, resource, budget, or control risks.

Experience with technology-enabled transformation, including intake and prioritization of technology demand, business case development, budget planning, investment tracking, workflow design, automation, data, reporting, or tooling enhancements.

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
KAIROS, Inc is searching for an energetic, experienced, and highly motivated Security Manager to join our team.

Established in July 2013, KAIROS, Inc. is a growing Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) specializing in Life Cycle Program Management, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Logistics and Sustainment, Enterprise Platforms and AI, and Additive Manufacturing services focused on optimizing customers’ program performance and mission through proven methodologies and ethical practices. Our headquarters is in California, MD, near Naval Air Station Patuxent River. We offer competitive salaries and benefits with outstanding growth potential.

The Security Manager will serve as KAIROS’ Facility Security Officer (FSO) responsible for administering and implementing the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and ensuring compliance with Government security requirements that support personnel, facilities, information, and classified operations. The Security Manager will support facility and personnel clearance processing and management, visit certifications, and security education and training.

Primary Duties

Process personnel security actions including visit requests, clearance verification, indoctrinations, debriefings, and access authorizations.
Maintain classified document accountability, storage, destruction, reproduction, transmission, and inventory records.
Coordinate classified visits, visitor control procedures, and foreign visitor requests.
Conduct security briefings, annual refresher training, and security awareness education for program personnel.
Work closely with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), Government security personnel, KAIROS leadership, Contracts, prime contractors, and Human Resources to administer personnel security, physical security, document control, visitor management, classified material accountability, and security education programs.
Perform self-inspections, security audits, and internal compliance assessments while identifying corrective actions.
Maintain security records, Standard Practice Procedures (SPPs), emergency action plans, and facility accreditation documentation.
Investigate and report security incidents, violations, and suspicious activities in accordance with Government reporting requirements.
Serve as Insider Threat Program Senior Official (ITPSO). Coordinate insider threat awareness and training activities.
Support subcontractor security coordination and ensure compliance with contractual security requirements.
Prepare for and support DCSA security reviews, audits, and inspections
Maintain accountability for COMSEC, controlled unclassified information (CUI), and classified materials, as applicable
Promote security best practices and continuous process improvement to protect personnel, facilities, and classified information.

Skills and Qualifications:

Strong understanding of personnel security processes, including clearance processing, onboarding, and reinvestigations.
Ability to safeguard classified information and ensure compliance with security handling, storage, and transmission procedures.
Strong customer relations, analytics, and documentation skills
Self-starter, highly motivated, strong work ethic with a commitment to quality
Microsoft Office suite proficiency, i.e., Word, Excel, PowerPoint
Ability to work within a challenging, fast-paced, team-oriented environment
Ability to work independently
Ability to multi-task and meet competing, deliverable deadlines
Strong attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to provide clear status and/or communicate issues
Ability to adapt to evolving technology

Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, security management, homeland security, business administration, information security, or a related field.
In lieu of a degree, additional years of experience as an FSO may be substituted
Seven (7) to ten (10) years of experience supporting industrial security, personnel security, physical security, or security administration for Government or Department of Defense programs.
Experience administering facility security programs under the National Industrial Security Program (NISP)
Experience with the following: National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), DISS (Defense Information System for Security), National Background Investigation Services (NBIS), National Industrial Security System (NISS), e-QIP/eAPP, SWFT, and other Government security systems
Experience managing multiple classified contracts simultaneously
Experience supporting Special Access Programs (SAP), SCI, or COMSEC requirements
Completion of DCSA/Center for Development of Security Excellence (CDSE) FSO Program Management and Industrial Security coursework, desired

Clearance:

This position is subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. In order to complete the requirements for a government security clearance investigation, you must be a U.S. Citizen and be able to complete the full background investigation. This position requires an Active Top Secret Security Clearance.

Compensation

While skills, education, and experience are key factors, they are not the sole determinants of salary. Other determining factors include, but are not limited to location, contract budgets and requirements, and government labor category guidelines. The estimated salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00. KAIROS also provides a comprehensive benefits package as additional employee compensation.

KAIROS, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Red Team - Offensive Security Analyst - Manager
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY Technology:

Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:

Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster, and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.

Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.

The opportunity

The Active Defense team is responsible for four core areas: Adversarial Testing (Purple Team), Proactive Threat Hunting, Anomaly Analysis, and Cyber Deception. This function plays a critical role in strengthening and maturing the firm’s enterprise security capabilities through threat-informed defense and continuous validation of security controls.

We are seeking an Active Defense Analyst with a strong information security background and a passion for using offensive security techniques to improve defensive outcomes. In its Purple Team capacity, the role will emulate adversary behaviors, validate security detections and defensive controls, and identify opportunities to enhance the effectiveness of security operations and incident response teams. In its Threat Hunting capacity, the analyst will proactively identify malicious activity, suspicious behaviors, and emerging threats through analysis of security telemetry, SIEM data, EDR platforms, threat intelligence, and other relevant sources.

The successful candidate will communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate across teams to identify, prioritize, and remediate security gaps. The position requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Essential Functions of the job:

Perform research and analysis of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), and emulate those attacks in a collaborative and controlled environment.
Conduct proactive threat hunting operations leveraging SIEM, EDR, threat intelligence, and other security telemetry sources to identify malicious activity and previously unknown threats.
Identify patterns consistent with sophisticated attacker methodologies, and report on security concerns as they are escalated or identified.
Evaluate, develop, and operationalize Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) capabilities to enhance cyber defense operations, including threat detection, threat hunting, anomaly detection, adversary emulation, attack simulation, and security automation.
Analyze digital artifacts, forensic evidence, logs, malware samples, and system telemetry collected during adversarial testing, investigations, and threat hunting activities.
Communicate with system owners, custodians, and IT stakeholders to facilitate security testing activities, including obtaining access to systems, digital artifact collection, and remediation activities.
Develop and present technical findings, attack narratives, risk assessments, and remediation recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders using written reports, presentations, and executive briefings.
Maintain, manage, improve, and update security testing processes, procedures, and protocol documentation.
Identify means to disrupt attacker actions, validate security detections and defensive controls, identify coverage gaps, and enhance defender response capabilities.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

6+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: Red Teaming, Purple Teaming, Offensive Security Operations, Exploit Development, Penetration Testing, Security Research, or similar roles.
Demonstrated understanding of common and advanced cyber-attack vectors, exploitation methodologies, and intrusion set tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
Knowledge of incident response processes and the integration of red and purple team findings into defensive operations and remediation efforts.
Good understanding of Windows and Unix/Linux operating systems.
Understanding of IP networking concepts, including addressing, routing, common network protocols, and the use of proxies, load balancers, firewalls, routers, and switches within enterprise architectures.
Understanding of security concepts across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid enterprise environments.
Global mindset for working with different cultures and backgrounds
Demonstrated integrity and judgment within a professional environment
Ability to appropriately balance work/personal priorities
Teaming skills as well as ability to work independently on tasks
Good social, communication, and writing skills

Qualifications, Certifications and Education requirements:

Associate’s degree or equivalent professional experience, and/or one or more of the following certifications: OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, GXPN, CISSP, GPEN, GCIH, GCFE, CFCE, other relevant GIAC certs.
Familiarity with EDR, SIEM, and SOAR technologies, detection engineering, threat hunting methodologies, security testing, scripting, and malware analysis techniques.

Preferred:

Extensive experience in applied enterprise hacking techniques (red/purple-teaming) across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
Experience with adversary emulation frameworks, attack simulation platforms, and threat-informed defense methodologies.
Background in DevSecOps, with the ability to rapidly build and deploy test scenarios to validate cyber threats and security concerns.
Hands-on experience as an administrator configuring one or more of SIEM, SOAR, Endpoint Protection, Vulnerability Scanners, or Data Loss Prevention
Proficient with one or more scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Perl, or similar languages in a threat intelligence, incident response, or cyber defense environment.
Experience evaluating emerging AI-enabled attack techniques and applying AI/ML technologies to enhance threat detection, adversary emulation, detection engineering, security automation, or cyber defense capability development.

Supervising Responsibilities:

The role requires mentoring, collaboration, and training of more junior associates.
On rare occasions, may be required to work nights or weekends in support of incident response or penetration audits.

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $128,100 to $239,600. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $153,800 to $272,300. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Leading security triage as the first port of call, assessing new CVEs, vulnerabilities and supply-chain risk against our real infrastructure, not just a checklist.

jobs.title: Information Security Manager
jobs.description:
We built our speech-to-text engine to understand every voice, in every accent, in every language, across customers who trust us with their audio and their data. That same care extends to how we protect that data and our own systems, and that's where you come in. We're hiring an Information Security Manager to make sure the rigour we put into understanding speech is matched by the rigour we put into keeping it safe.

What You'll Do

Leading security triage as the first port of call, assessing new CVEs, vulnerabilities and supply-chain risk against our real infrastructure, not just a checklist.
Running hands-on audits covering pen testing, vulnerability management, supply-chain security, bringing technical judgement, not just policy references.
Owning our governance, risk and compliance frameworks, and keeping them honest, turning policy into controls that actually work at the infrastructure and code level.
Automating the parts of GRC that don't need a human (vulnerability tooling, endpoint protection rollout, policy-to-enforcement mapping), so the function scales without the busywork.
Building real product and infrastructure knowledge, so you become the person people come to, not the person who has to go find someone else.

What You'll Bring

A technical background you can back up: Computer Science, Information Security, or similar, plus real experience in cybersecurity or IT security management.
CISSP or CISM (or equivalent depth of experience). We care more about the substance than the letters.
A track record in incident management and governance, risk and control frameworks, ideally somewhere that also demanded technical credibility, not just process.
The confidence to say "that policy doesn't reflect how this actually works", and the technical grounding to be right.
A bias toward automating and simplifying, not toward adding another layer of sign-off.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who We Are

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What We Can Offer You

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there.

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community.
We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
